description: This file defines a PHP interface 'ValueXNormalizable' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Report\FilterField'. The interface declares a single method 'toArrayXValue' which is intended to normalize the 'x' value of a SelectedFilterField object for reporting purposes.

classes.name: ValueXNormalizable
classes.description: An interface defining a method for normalizing the 'x' value of a filter field object.

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Method intended to normalize and represent the 'x' value of a SelectedFilterField as an array, possibly returning null if normalization is not applicable.
